user.title: Comelit Local
user.description: Enter the gateway IP address and a dedicated Home Assistant user token. Stop any other integration using the same token before connecting. See the README for token instructions. This version adds the gateway only; buttons, ring events and video come later.

error.invalid_host: Enter a valid gateway IP address, without a URL or port.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the gateway. Check its IP address, ViP port and network connection.
